name: What types of windows are best for resisting water damage in the Bay Area climate?

mainEntity.name: What types of windows are best for resisting water damage in the Bay Area climate?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Bay Area climate, which can experience both fog and heavy rains, windows with robust construction and excellent sealing properties are crucial. Vinyl or fiberglass frames are often recommended for their resistance to moisture, rot, and corrosion. Look for features like fusion-welded corners, multiple weatherstripping layers, and effective drainage systems. Low-E, dual-pane glass also helps with insulation and condensation management.
acceptedAnswer.description: Vinyl or fiberglass windows with strong seals, fusion-welded corners, and good drainage are recommended for the Bay Area's climate.
